en.headline: Fire at Lam Tin public housing flat injures residents and forces evacuation
en.dek: Blaze at Kai Wong House in Kai Tin Estate started around 1:43pm; firefighters brought it under control in about 20 minutes with preliminary signs of an electrical fault.
body: A fire broke out in a residential unit at Kai Wong House in Kai Tin Estate, Lam Tin, at about 1:43pm on Tuesday, with flames and thick black smoke visible from a high-floor flat.

Firefighters responded quickly, deploying water jets and search teams. The Fire Services Department brought the blaze under control and extinguished it within roughly 20 minutes. Residents on the affected floors evacuated, with about 20 people reported to have fled to safety in initial accounts, while some reports put the number higher.

Two people were treated for injuries related to the incident, according to reports. Preliminary investigations suggested the fire may have been caused by a short circuit in a power strip or electrical fault in the unit. Police and fire services are continuing to examine the cause.
The incident caused temporary disruption for residents of the public housing estate. No further injuries or major structural damage were immediately reported beyond the affected flat.

zh.headline: 藍田啟田邨啟旺樓單位火警 居民疏散有人受傷
zh.dek: 事發於下午約1時43分，消防員約20分鐘內將火救熄，初步懷疑電路故障或電源排插短路引起。
body: 藍田啟田邨啟旺樓一個高層單位於周二下午約1時43分發生火警，火舌從窗戶湧出，濃煙升上半空，有市民報案。
消防接報後迅速到場，出動水喉及煙帽隊灌救。消防處約20分鐘後將火勢控制並撲滅。涉事樓層居民疏散，初步有約20人自行離開，部分報道指疏散人數較多。
報道指有兩人因事件受傷或不適接受治理。初步調查顯示，火警可能由電源排插短路或單位內電路故障引起。警方及消防正繼續調查起火原因。
事件令該公共屋邨部分居民受影響，目前未有進一步嚴重傷亡或大範圍結構損壞的報告。
